claims.text: The Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni eutectic alloy initially has a continuous dual-phase lamellar microstructure.
The two lamellar phases in the initial Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy are ordered B2 and disordered BCC.
The initial alloy suffers catastrophic cracking at phase interfaces during room-temperature tension.
The initial alloy has low room-temperature ductility.
The proposed treatment consists of severe plastic deformation followed by a 600–800 °C isothermal hold under 1.5–2.5 GPa hydrostatic pressure.
The proposed treatment will transform the continuous lamellae into an inverted BCC+B2 microstructure.
An inverted BCC+B2 microstructure consists of discrete B2 precipitates dispersed in a continuous BCC matrix.
Severe plastic deformation introduces a high dislocation density and breaks the continuity of the lamellae.
Extreme hydrostatic pressure alters interfacial energy and diffusion kinetics in this alloy.
The pressure-induced changes favor discrete precipitate nucleation over planar lamellar growth.
Dislocations introduced by severe plastic deformation provide nucleation sites for B2 precipitates in the BCC matrix.
A continuous ordered B2 phase causes poor ductility and provides brittle crack-propagation pathways.
Converting the continuous B2 phase into discrete precipitates eliminates continuous crack paths and arrests interfacial cracking.
Dislocations will bypass or shear the discrete B2 precipitates through Orowan looping or precipitate shearing.
The precipitate topology will relieve stress concentrations and promote uniform plasticity.
The treatment will produce more than 10% room-temperature tensile elongation.
The treatment will increase fracture toughness without a proportional loss of yield strength.
Conventional HIP at 100–200 MPa densifies the alloy but maintains or coarsens its original lamellar structure without phase inversion.
A pressure above approximately 1.5 GPa is required for phase inversion, whereas lower pressure will leave the lamellae intact or cause coarsening.
Phase stability and B2-ordering kinetics in this alloy are highly sensitive to the precise Al/Ni ratio.

contradictions.description: The intervention window includes 1.5 GPa, while the conditions and boundary require pressure strictly greater than 1.5 GPa.
